data.description: From the Result Validator report, row 107 (AC-92), the one failing clause: the plan's pass condition says build_deck.py's ledger write is gone, but mvp/tools/build_deck.py:220-234 (slot_for_meetup) still writes mvp/answer-history.json on every build (line 233). CLAUDE.md names this footgun (a deck built for a meetup that does not happen falsely retires a question; it happened 2026-08-12 and was rolled back by hand) and says no code satisfies AC-92's record of what each meetup used. T-19 (PQ-24) declined to port the write but did not retire it (G-10). mvp/ is contract-protected and October runs on the MVP deck, so this is HELD on the client's clearance to touch mvp/tools/build_deck.py. Shape when cleared: remove the write (the ledger stays a record written at run time, by hand or by the room's release), keep the deck build otherwise identical, and say in mvp/README.md how the ledger is recorded after a meetup. Acceptance: building a deck writes nothing to answer-history.json; the existing deck output is byte-identical for the same inputs.
data.title: Retire build_deck.py's ledger write at build time

data.body: AUDIT from the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md, audit tree 0c7d60a): GAP-20 (G-10, Major) is this ticket: build_deck.py:220-234 still writes the ledger at build; sufficient. GAP-3 (G-1, Minor) adds scope: build_deck.py:96-109 (answer_slots) balances answer positions in the multi-question deck. Retire answer_slots along with slot_for_meetup's write.

CANCELLED (client, 2026-10-11: 'cancel PQ-46'). The MVP deck is retired: the built room plus docs/RUNBOOK.md (its successor) runs the segment, and the room's backup is popquiz.fallback (PQ-52), not the deck. With no deck builds, build_deck.py's build-time ledger write cannot fire. mvp/ stays for its templates (PRACTICE-RUN, FIELD-NOTES-TEMPLATE, README 'The shape') and the answer-history record. Not done here: CLAUDE.md's 'build the deck with --only <qid>' line still tells agents to build a deck; that is the client's file and a separate change.
